credits: Painted from family photos of Olivia, Zero, Belle, and home.
title: Olivia and the House on the Hill
subtitle: Home is the white house.
blurb: Olivia walks the red clay in front of her long white house — dark metal roof, wooden deck, white pickup, woods all around — and learns the shape of home.

magic.home: The white house kept them. That is what home does.

pages.heading: The white house
pages.text: {Olivia} stood in the red clay and looked up. Long white walls. A dark metal roof. A little wooden deck. "That is my {home}," she told the woods, in case the woods did not know.

pages.heading: The little deck
pages.text: The deck was a wooden pocket on the front. A black door. A wreath. {Olivia:olivia/wave} waved from the clay as if she were arriving from far away, which she was not, but it felt true.

pages.heading: The white truck
pages.text: A white pickup slept on the clay like a big tame animal. {Zero:zero/sniff} sniffed a tire. {Belle:belle/wag} wanted to climb it. {Olivia} said, "Not today."

pages.heading: The woods around
pages.text: Green woods wrapped the hill the way arms wrap a sleep. {Olivia:olivia/ask} liked that. Home was not just a house. Home was the trees that kept it company.

pages.heading: Around the corner
pages.text: Around the corner, the {garden} tables waited, and the gravel, and the glass doors. {Olivia:olivia/run} knew every turn. Knowing a place is a kind of love.

pages.heading: Inside
pages.text: {Olivia} climbed the deck. {Zero:zero/sleep} and {Belle:belle/wag} came too. The black door opened. The white house took them in, the way it always does. That is the whole trick of home.

end.heading: The End
end.text: You {read} the whole {story}. Home is the white house on the hill, and the woods, and who walks in.
end.prompt: What does your home look like from the outside?
